title: Harcore
description: Changes all references from Hardcore to Harcore
body:
Changes all references from Hardcore to Harcore.

For reference, Mojang is adding Hardcore to Minecraft Bedrock, but they mispelled Hardcore as Harcore. Watch [Phoenix SC's video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=goAoULHs9VI) for where I got inspiration from.
